parsedVerdict.reasoning: This infrastructure-layer file holds an in-memory persistence adapter for the Order aggregate. Its methods (save, findById, findAll, delete and exists) only store and retrieve data. That is a persistence job, which fits the infrastructure layer. The file has no business rules, no checks on order state, no use-case orchestration and no presentation or transport logic. The @Injectable decorator is framework wiring, which also belongs in infrastructure. The application handlers inject the concrete class directly, which is a question of dependency direction or dependency inversion. That is out of scope here.
